title: PrismPM Twin Lift Commitment
description: Byte-exact commitment for the Phase Mirror Adversarial Twin lift harness. A lift_id is stable across two runs iff every field below is canonicalized before hashing. This schema is the last perimeter gate before a ContractivityReceipt may be minted.

atlas.description: Ordered map from atlas index to prime. Serialized as a JSON object with string keys in ascending integer order; the digest depends on this exact ordering.

edges.description: Sorted pairs in atlas index space. Sorted lexicographically by (i, j); HashSet iteration order is banned.

lambda_exact.description: Exact rational adjacency plus gain table, row-major. f64 probes are not Lambda_exact.

chain_ids.description: Canonical request encoding. The LAST request is included; windows(2) drops it.

r_bound.description: Declared algorithm + type. A 1-norm power-iteration probe must never be advertised as r(Lambda).

lift_id.description: H(atlas || edges || Lambda_exact || chain_ids) as a lowercase hex SHA-256 digest.
